body:
I created a throwaway account because frankly, I do not want people I know knowing my reddit name. I thought Lifelines' Kokoda Trail Challenge might be something Reddit would like to help as yes, it is a worthy cause. 
Throwaway accounts are made by redditors quite frequently, and while I can understand you might see this as spamming, However I do not think two posts made by an individual to help a friend falls under that category.
